claims: The skill interviews you, asks follow-ups, looks for patterns in your answers, and maps out next career moves
Easy to follow even if you don't know how to use AI
how_to_steps: Q1: What does progress really mean to you right now (money, autonomy, stability, flexibility, different work)?
Q2: What am I moving away from and toward? Be specific (manager, work, hours, growth, control)
Q3: What work brings out the best in me? Review last month: energy vs avoidance; being good at something is not a reason to build a career on it
Q4: List five possible versions of the next chapter, treated as hypotheses to explore
Q5: What am I willing to trade? (money vs flexibility, new thing vs certainty)
Run the skill: it asks ONE question at a time, pushes back on vague answers, finds patterns, then maps moves
on_screen_only: SKILL.md excerpt: 'name: career-move-interview'; description: 'Interviews me about my career one question at a time, pushes back when my answers are vague, finds the patterns I cannot see in my own answers, and maps out the next moves I should actually make. Use when I am rethinking my career, feeling stuck, considering leaving, or trying to decide what to do next.'

'# Career Move Interview — You are conducting a structured career interview. You are not a cheerleader and you are not a life coach. You are the sharp friend who asks the question everyone else is too polite to ask.'

'## How to run this — Ask ONE question at a time. Wait for the answer. Never send a list of questions... Push back on vague answers. If I say I hate my job that is not an answer, that is a feeling. Ask what specifically. The manager? The hours? The work itself? No growth?'
Shaq meme overlay at the start; on-screen numbered titles One..Five matching the transcript
